action_items: Eliminate browser-visible dashboard bootstrap GET aborts during immediate dashboard -> Tile Orders route changes.

Validate route lifecycle behavior together with floor-switch navigation path (Tile Orders navigation may trigger a full-page transition when current floor is not ground-floor, which can abort in-flight dashboard reads).
Re-test desktop and phone rapid navigation after fix and confirm: zero aborted dashboard GETs, zero aborted /api/followups/reconcile POSTs, zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.tsx correctly uses a focus-version stale-response guard with delayed load and no explicit AbortController cancellation in this file, but network aborts are still reproducible in rapid navigation traces.

(admin)/_layout.tsx useTilesNav.open() performs window.location.assign(...) when active floor is not ground-floor before opening Tile Orders; this full-page transition can terminate in-flight dashboard requests and surface net::ERR_ABORTED in browser tooling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (owner@forge.app). Rapid navigation reproduces aborted dashboard GETs on both desktop and phone. No aborted /api/followups/reconcile POST and no console error logs were observed. One phone run had a strict-selector assertion issue and was rerun with corrected selector.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: login -> rapidly alternate dashboard and Tile Orders. Result: net::ERR_ABORTED on dashboard bootstrap GET endpoints. Likely contributing factor: lifecycle timing plus route/floor transition behavior; specifically, Tile Orders navigation path can trigger a full browser navigation when floor correction to ground-floor occurs, terminating in-flight dashboard requests.
